title: "Mary Agou"

Your exploratory data analysis of the team datasets go here.



```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(rmarkdown)
nhl_games<-read_csv("../data/raw/nhl_games_2024_2026.csv")
pwl_games<-read.csv("../data/raw/pwhl_games_2024_2026.csv")

```


```{r}
pwl_games |>
  filter(!is.na(goal), !is.na(shot_quality)) |>
  group_by(shot_quality) |>
  summarise(goals = sum(goal == 1)) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = goals, x = fct_reorder(shot_quality, goals))) +
  geom_point(
    size = 6,
    colour = "#E76F51"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Goals by Shot Quality",
    subtitle = "Which shot qualities produce the most goals?",
    x = "Shot Quality",
    y = "Number of Goals",
    caption = "Source: PWHL games, 2024–2026"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 18, face = "bold", colour = "#264653"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "gray40"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )





```




```{r}
#| eval: false

#renamed the goal to be numeric instead of logical
pwl_games<-pwl_games|>
  mutate(goal=as.numeric(goal))

pwl_games|>
    filter(!is.na(goal))|>
  filter(!is.na(shot_quality))|>
count(goal,shot_quality)|>
  ggplot(aes(shot_quality,y=n,colour = goal))+
  geom_point(size = 5)+
  coord_flip()
```
```{r}

library(tidyverse)

pwl_games |>
  filter(!is.na(goal)) |>
  group_by(player_name_first, player_name_last) |>
  summarise(goals = sum(goal), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(player = paste(player_name_first, player_name_last)) |>
  slice_max(goals, n = 20) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = goals, y = fct_reorder(player, goals))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2A9D8F", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = goals), hjust = -0.4, size = 3.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 20 Goal Scorers",
    subtitle = "Players with the most goals in the PWHL dataset",
    x = "Total Goals",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: PWHL game data"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```
